page_title: VEN 0-0 NAP | Venezia v Napoli 16/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+5' That was a nice football moment. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Alex Meret guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
90+5' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+5' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee points to the corner flag and Napoli will take a corner.

90+4' Jay Idzes (Venezia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Maurizio Mariani with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+4' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) sends a long ball forward to Matteo Politano, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
90+3' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!
90+2' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is penalised for holding. Maurizio Mariani signals a set piece.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' A pass from Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) is intercepted by Alex Meret and the move breaks down.
89' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
88' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
87' The game has come to an end for Mikael Egill Ellertsson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia).
87' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Gianluca Busio (Venezia) replaces Kike Perez.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) for Romelu Lukaku.
86' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
86' 10:14 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:7.
83' Matteo Politano (Napoli) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
82' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Christian Gytkjaer, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
82' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
80' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Matteo Politano (Napoli), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

80' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for an infringement. Napoli are awarded a free kick.
77' It will be a substitution. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Billy Gilmour walks off.
77' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is being substituted because of an injury. Antonio Conte sends Juan Jesus on the pitch.
76' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Giacomo Raspadori and he is replaced by Noah Okafor (Napoli).
76' Leonardo Spinazzola will be replaced by Mathias Olivera (Napoli).
75' The game is interrupted now, Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' Kike Perez (Venezia) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
73' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The linesman makes the right call and Venezia will have a corner.
71' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Venezia was in an offside position.
70' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) replacing Daniel Fila.
70' The substitution has been made. Issa Doumbia (Venezia) has replaced Alfred Duncan.
69' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
69' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
68' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
68' An attempted cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
67' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' Matteo Politano (Napoli) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Ionut Radu is alert and denies him with a nice save.
64' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

63' Matteo Politano (Napoli) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Napoli earn a corner.
62' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
60' Ionut Radu (Venezia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

59' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but Ionut Radu punches the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes a short free kick.
58' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle after Kike Perez (Venezia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Napoli win a free kick.
57' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sprays a pass out to Romelu Lukaku, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
55' He should have scored! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
54' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) attempts to find Romelu Lukaku, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
49' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner with a short pass.

49' Scott McTominay (Napoli) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
48' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and it's Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
47' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
47' Good defending. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) tries to find Daniel Fila inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+2' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered. The game is interrupted now, Ionut Radu (Venezia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

45+2' Ionut Radu pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' What a save from Ionut Radu! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
44' Matteo Politano (Napoli) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
43' Fali Cande (Venezia) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
43' Fouls committed – 11:1.

42' Kike Perez (Venezia) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Meret is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. Daniel Fila (Venezia) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.

41' Scott McTominay (Napoli) climbs high to meet a delightful cross from the corner and heads from the edge of the box towards the underside of the crossbar. It lacks accuracy, however, and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
41' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) will deliver the corner kick.
40' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.

39' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
38' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make a change. Mirko Maric is unable to continue due to injury, Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) comes on.
37' Mirko Maric (Venezia) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
36' Mirko Maric (Venezia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) tackles a bit over-zealously and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
33' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
32' Kike Perez (Venezia) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
31' A pass into the penalty area from Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) is intercepted by the defence. Venezia have a corner.

30' Scott McTominay (Napoli) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, and he produces a promising goal-bound header to the bottom right corner, but Ionut Radu pulls off a decent save to deny him.
29' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Napoli will take a free kick near the side line.
26' Referee Maurizio Mariani sees the trip by Fali Cande (Venezia) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
24' Ionut Radu (Venezia) sends a long ball forward to Mikael Egill Ellertsson, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
23' Daniel Fila (Venezia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Meret intercepts the ball.
22' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
21' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a throw-in.
19' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

19' What a great chance for Scott McTominay (Napoli). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
18' Matteo Politano (Napoli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

18' Great save! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the top right corner was brilliantly saved by Ionut Radu. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Napoli.
17' Total attempts – 5:1. 1:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

16' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies well wide of the right post towards the corner flag. Very poor shot.
15' Foul! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. It's a free kick to Venezia, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
15' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
13' Daniel Fila (Venezia) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alex Meret with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
12' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
12' Daniel Fila (Venezia) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
10' Scott McTominay is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli).
8' Daniel Fila links up with Kike Perez (Venezia), who fires just over the bar from the edge of the box.
7' What a chance that is! Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
7' Kike Perez (Venezia) takes a short corner kick.
6' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Daniel Fila, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
5' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
5' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) fails to score from inside the six-yard box as he sends his rebound against the left post.
4' It looks like Daniel Fila (Venezia) saw red with that tackle. Maurizio Mariani won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
3' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
2' One of the players from Napoli times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Kike Perez (Venezia) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Venezia will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Maurizio Mariani.
